==================================================
MAIN API INGESTION RULE
==================================================

Chosen base method: PROTOTYPE ticketmaster.ts

Source file(s):
- /workspace/MERGEEVENTINGESTION/PROTOTYPE/services/ingestion/src/sources/ticketmaster.ts

Why:
- VERIFIED WORKING: 141 events successfully processed through full pipeline
- FULL PIPELINE: Source → Queue → Normalizer → Storage → Discovery
- PROPER FILTERING: Removes VIP/Package/Premium garbage
- VENUE VALIDATION: Rejects "undefined" venue names
- CATEGORY NORMALIZATION: Maps to DB category slugs
- DISCOVERY-READY: Extracts venue candidates and connections
- TYPE-SAFE: TypeScript with proper interfaces

==================================================
MANDATORY CHARACTERISTICS FOR FUTURE API SOURCES:
==================================================

1. FETCH METHOD
   - Use axios for HTTP requests (robust, tested)
   - API key via process.env with proper dotenv loading
   - Fail gracefully if key missing (log + skip)

2. EVENT FILTERING
   - Remove garbage events: VIP, Package, Premium, Platinum tiers
   - Validate venue names: reject "undefined", "null", empty strings
   - Filter to only real, usable events

3. DATA NORMALIZATION
   - Map source categories to DB category slugs
   - Use SEGMENT_TO_SLUG + GENRE_TO_SLUG pattern
   - Normalize all external data to internal format

4. PIPELINE INTEGRATION
   - Push events to rawEventsQueue for async processing
   - Use RawEventInput format from @eventpulse/shared
   - Include source_id, source, raw_payload for debugging

5. TYPE SAFETY
   - Use TypeScript with proper interfaces
   - Define event structure explicitly
   - Include unknown types where needed

6. ERROR HANDLING
   - Log errors with source prefix: [source-name]
   - Return status string: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'skipped'
   - Fail gracefully: log + continue, don't crash service

7. DISCOVERY SUPPORT (where applicable)
   - Extract venue candidates for multi-hop discovery
   - Track venue connections (promoters, attractions)
   - Push to discovery queues when possible

==================================================
TEMPLATE FOR NEW API SOURCES:
==================================================

// Source name: <source>.ts
// Location: services/ingestion/src/sources/<source>.ts

import axios from 'axios';
import { rawEventsQueue } from '../queue';
import type { RawEventInput } from '@eventpulse/shared';

const API_KEY = process.env.<SOURCE>_API_KEY;
const BASE_URL = 'https://api.<source>.com';

const SEGMENT_TO_SLUG: Record<string, string> = { /* ... */ };
const GENRE_TO_SLUG: Record<string, string> = { /* ... */ };

function normalizeCategory(segment: string, genre: string): string[] { /* ... */ }
function isValidEvent(event: any): boolean { /* ... */ }
function extractVenueName(event: any): string | null { /* ... */ }

export async function scrape<Source>(): Promise<string> {
  if (!API_KEY) {
    console.warn('[<source>] ⏭️ Skipping: <SOURCE>_API_KEY not configured');
    return 'skipped';
  }

  console.log('[<source>] Starting scrape...');

  try {
    const response = await axios.get(`${BASE_URL}/events`, {
      params: { apikey: API_KEY, /* ... */ },
    });
    const events = response.data.events ?? [];
    console.log(`[<source>] ${events.length} events found`);

    for (const ev of events) {
      if (!isValidEvent(ev)) continue;

      const raw: RawEventInput = {
        title: ev.name,
        description: ev.description ?? null,
        start_time: ev.startTime ?? null,
        venue_name: extractVenueName(ev),
        categories: normalizeCategory(ev.segment, ev.genre),
        source: '<source>',
        source_id: ev.id,
        raw_payload: ev as Record<string, unknown>,
        // ... other fields
      };

      await rawEventsQueue.add(`<source>:${ev.id}`, raw);
    }

    console.log(`[<source>] ✅ Queued ${events.length} events`);
    return 'completed';
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[<source>] Failed:', err.message);
    return 'failed';
  }
}

==================================================
🚫 MOCK DATA PROHIBITION - ABSOLUTE RULE 🚫
==================================================

MOCK DATA IS FORBIDDEN IN EVENTPULSE PIPELINE.

This rule supersedes all other rules. Violations will be corrected immediately.

PURPOSE:
--------
EventPulse aggregates real event data for users. Fake/mock/sample data:
- Breaks user trust
- Pollutes the database with garbage
- Makes analytics meaningless
- Creates false expectations

SCOPE - ALL COMPONENTS:
-----------------------
1. FETCH / SCRAPER
   - Never generate events with hardcoded titles/descriptions
   - Never use "sample", "mock", "fake", "placeholder" data
   - Never create events "for testing" that persist to production DB
   - Only fetch from real, verified APIs or web scraping

2. QUEUE
   - Never push mock events to rawEventsQueue
   - Queue must only contain real event data
   - If source fails, queue nothing rather than queue fake data

3. NORMALIZER
   - Never normalize mock data
   - If input is fake, reject it entirely

4. DATABASE WRITE
   - Never write fake events to Supabase
   - Events table must contain ONLY real events
   - Delete any mock data found in database immediately

5. UI / FRONTEND
   - Never display mock events as real
   - Source labels must accurately describe the data source
   - CTA buttons must link to real event URLs

6. DOCUMENTATION
   - Any doc mentioning "sample", "mock", "test events" must be updated
   - New sources must be verified to use real data before activation

WHAT TO DO INSTEAD:
-------------------
If a source has no real data available:
1. Mark source as INACTIVE (return 'skipped')
2. Remove from sources list in index.ts
3. Remove from UI FALLBACK_PROVIDERS
4. Document why source is inactive
5. Keep placeholder code for future implementation (NO sample events)

ENFORCEMENT:
------------
- Any code generating fake events will be removed
- Any mock events in database will be deleted
- Any source named misleadingly will be renamed
- This rule is permanent and non-negotiable

-------------------------------

  - Root cause: stockholm.com blocked by Cloudflare, developer generated "samples"
  - Fix: Source marked INACTIVE, mock events deleted from DB
  - Lesson: Never replace unavailable data with fake data

==================================================
END OF RULE
==================================================
